subject: gk
question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): India’s position in the Global Happiness Index is lower than several other South Asian nations.

Reason (R): India records the lowest per capita income among South Asian countries.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
The correct answer is __**A is true, but R is false.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Global Happiness Index** is an annual report published by the **United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)**.
 
• The Index ranks countries based on various factors such as **social support, income, life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perceptions of corruption**.
 
• India's position in the Global Happiness Index has been consistently **lower compared to several other South Asian nations** like Bhutan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka in recent years.
 
• While India's ranking is low, the claim in the **Reason (R)** that India records the lowest **per capita income** among South Asian nations is incorrect.
 
• Countries like Nepal and Afghanistan have **lower per capita income** than India, as per data provided by organizations like the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** and the **World Bank**.
 
• The disparity in the Happiness Index ranking is not solely attributed to income levels but also includes other factors like **social welfare, governance, equality, and mental well-being**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Global Happiness Index**__

 __
 
• The **World Happiness Report** is based on a survey conducted in over **150 countries**.
 
• Key metrics include **real GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, and corruption levels.**
 
• **Finland** has consistently ranked as the happiest country in recent years.
 
 
 
• **South Asia**__
 __
 
• South Asia includes countries like **India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, and Maldives**.
 
• **Bhutan** is known for prioritizing the concept of **Gross National Happiness** over GDP.
 
• **Afghanistan** often ranks the lowest globally in the Happiness Index due to ongoing **conflicts and instability**.
 
 
 
• **Per Capita Income**__
 
 
• Per capita income is a measure of the **average income earned per person** in a given area in a specified year.
 
• It is calculated by dividing the **total income of a country** by its population.
 
• India’s per capita income is higher than countries like **Nepal** and **Afghanistan**, as per the latest data from international organizations.
